I made both edits in `src/flask/sansio/scaffold.py`. `patch` now calls `self.route(...)` directly, and the new `options_route` comes right after it. I haven't run the tests.

One side effect: `patch` used to go through `_method_route`, which raises a `TypeError` if someone passes a `methods=` argument. Now it skips that check. If a caller passes `methods=...` to `patch`, it will clash with the hardcoded `methods=["PATCH"]` and Python will raise its own duplicate-keyword `TypeError` instead of Flask's clearer message.

After the change, a search of `src/flask/` finds five methods that call `_method_route` directly, all on `Scaffold`: `get`, `post`, `put`, `delete` and `options_route`. `patch` no longer calls it.
